description: Work on a saved design itself: every later edit is part of it once you export `imgly`. Pass the `uri` an `import`, an `export` or `designs` gave you, verbatim. To start from a copy instead, `import` its `uri`. Returns `{ uri, title }`.

discard.description: Drop the unsaved edits of the design you are on. Set it ONLY when that work is meant to be thrown away (the user said so, or it was a throwaway sketch); otherwise save it first with `export({ format: 'imgly' })`. Never set it by default.

name: open
